as_told.title: Diana Pasulka on second-century Latin written on rockets

plain: Inscriptions in second-century Latin were put on some NASA missions, written on the rockets themselves. Michels says the religious studies professor Diana Pasulka told him this, and he brings it up in two episodes. In one he places the words on the fairing, the nose cone that shields a rocket's cargo, though he says he is not sure.
